description: Defines a mock repository class for storing and retrieving progress data in-memory, primarily for testing purposes. It provides methods to get progress for a specific lesson and to upsert progress entries.

classes.name: MockProgressRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of a progress repository storing progress data in-memory for testing.

methods.name: getProgressForLesson
methods.description: Retrieves the progress for a specific lesson, wrapped in a Future.

methods.name: upsertProgress
methods.description: Creates or updates a progress entry for a lesson, setting the lastUpdated timestamp to now.
